37 function clearSeries() {
38 points = []
39 canvas.requestPaint()
40 }

42 function appendPoint(x, y) {
43 var list = points.slice(0)
44 list.push({"x": x, "y": y})
45 if (list.length > maxPoints) {
46 list = list.slice(list.length - maxPoints)
47 }
48 points = list
49 canvas.requestPaint()
50 }
51
52 function _minY() {
53 if (points.length <= 0) return -1
54 var minV = points[0].y
55 for (var i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
56 if (points[i].y < minV) minV = points[i].y
57 }
58 return minV
59 }
60
61 function _maxY() {
62 if (points.length <= 0) return 1
63 var maxV = points[0].y
64 for (var i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
65 if (points[i].y > maxV) maxV = points[i].y
66 }
67 return maxV
68 }
69
70 function _niceStep(rawStep) {
71 if (!Number.isFinite(rawStep) || rawStep <= 0) {
72 return 1
73 }
74 var power = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(rawStep)))
75 var normalized = rawStep / power
76 var nice = 1
77 if (normalized <= 1) {
78 nice = 1
79 } else if (normalized <= 2) {
80 nice = 2
81 } else if (normalized <= 5) {
82 nice = 5
83 } else {
84 nice = 10
85 }
86 return nice * power
87 }
88
89 function _rangeY() {
90 var minV = _minY()
91 var maxV = _maxY()
92 if (!Number.isFinite(minV) || !Number.isFinite(maxV)) {
93 return {"min": -1, "max": 1, "step": 0.5}
94 }
95 var span = Math.max(1e-9, maxV - minV)
96 var step = _niceStep(span / 4.0)
97 var yMin = Math.floor(minV / step) * step
98 var yMax = Math.ceil(maxV / step) * step
99 if (Math.abs(yMax - yMin) < 1e-9) {
100 yMin -= step
101 yMax += step
102 }
103 return {"min": yMin, "max": yMax, "step": step}
104 }
105
106 function _axisDecimals(step) {
107 if (!Number.isFinite(step) || step <= 0) {
108 return 2
109 }
110 if (step >= 1) {
111 return 2
112 }
113 return Math.min(7, Math.max(2, Math.ceil(-Math.log10(step)) + 1))
114 }
115
116 function _formatAxisValue(value, step) {
117 if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
118 return "--"
119 }
120 var absV = Math.abs(value)
121 if (absV > 0 && absV < 1e-3) {
122 return value.toExponential(2)
123 }
124 return value.toFixed(_axisDecimals(step))
125 }
126
127 function _rangeX() {
128 var xMin = axisMinX
129 var xMax = Math.max(axisMinX + 1e-9, axisMaxX)
130
131 if (!autoCompressX || points.length <= 0) {
132 return {"min": xMin, "max": xMax}
133 }
134
135 var latestX = Number(points[points.length - 1].x)
136 if (!Number.isFinite(latestX)) {
137 return {"min": xMin, "max": xMax}
138 }
139
140 // Keep growing visible X range when newest sample is about to hit right border.
141 var effectiveMin = 0.0
142 var effectiveMax = Math.max(minRangeX, xMax)
143 while (latestX >= effectiveMax * xOverflowThreshold) {
144 effectiveMax *= Math.max(1.05, xExpandFactor)
145 }
146 return {"min": effectiveMin, "max": effectiveMax}
147 }

179 onPaint: {
180 var ctx = getContext("2d")
181 ctx.reset()
182
183 var w = width
184 var h = height
185
186 ctx.fillStyle = "#03070D"
187 ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)
188
189 var padL = 36
190 var padR = 12
191 var padT = 10
192 var padB = 24
193
194 var plotW = Math.max(10, w - padL - padR)
195 var plotH = Math.max(10, h - padT - padB)
196
197 ctx.strokeStyle = "#334A62"
198 ctx.lineWidth = 1
199
200 for (var gx = 0; gx <= 10; gx++) {
201 var xx = padL + (plotW * gx / 10.0)
202 ctx.beginPath()
203 ctx.moveTo(xx, padT)
204 ctx.lineTo(xx, padT + plotH)
205 ctx.stroke()
206 }
207
208 for (var gy = 0; gy <= 8; gy++) {
209 var yy = padT + (plotH * gy / 8.0)
210 ctx.beginPath()
211 ctx.moveTo(padL, yy)
212 ctx.lineTo(padL + plotW, yy)
213 ctx.stroke()
214 }
215
216 ctx.strokeStyle = "#D3BD45"
217 ctx.beginPath()
218 ctx.moveTo(padL, padT)
219 ctx.lineTo(padL, padT + plotH)
220 ctx.lineTo(padL + plotW, padT + plotH)
221 ctx.stroke()
222
223 var yRange = root._rangeY()
224 var yMin = yRange.min
225 var yMax = yRange.max
226 var yStep = yRange.step
227 var xRange = root._rangeX()
228 var xMin = xRange.min
229 var xMax = Math.max(xMin + 1e-9, xRange.max)
230
231 ctx.fillStyle = "#8DA6C0"
232 ctx.font = "11px Noto Sans"
233 ctx.fillText(root._formatAxisValue(yMax, yStep), 2, padT + 10)
234 ctx.fillText(root._formatAxisValue(yMin, yStep), 2, padT + plotH)
235 ctx.fillText(xMin.toFixed(1) + "s", padL, h - 4)
236 ctx.fillText(xMax.toFixed(1) + "s", padL + plotW - 30, h - 4)
237
238 if (points.length <= 0) {
239 return
240 }
241
242 ctx.strokeStyle = seriesColor
243 ctx.lineWidth = 2
244 ctx.beginPath()
245
246 var started = false
247 for (var i = 0; i < points.length; i++) {
248 var pxRaw = points[i].x
249 var pyRaw = points[i].y
250 if (pxRaw < xMin || pxRaw > xMax) {
251 continue
252 }
253
254 var nx = (pxRaw - xMin) / (xMax - xMin)
255 var ny = (pyRaw - yMin) / (yMax - yMin)
256 var px = padL + (nx * plotW)
257 var py = padT + ((1.0 - ny) * plotH)
258
259 if (!started) {
260 ctx.moveTo(px, py)
261 started = true
262 } else {
263 ctx.lineTo(px, py)
264 }
265 }
266
267 if (started) {
268 ctx.stroke()
269 }
270
271 var lastPoint = points[points.length - 1]
272 if (lastPoint.x >= xMin && lastPoint.x <= xMax) {
273 var lx = padL + ((lastPoint.x - xMin) / (xMax - xMin) * plotW)
274 var ly = padT + ((1.0 - ((lastPoint.y - yMin) / (yMax - yMin))) * plotH)
275 ctx.fillStyle = seriesColor
276 ctx.beginPath()
277 ctx.arc(lx, ly, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2, true)
278 ctx.fill()
279 }
280 }
281 }
